svg.aria-label: Component contributions and the full creep–recovery curve generated from one parameter set. The stacked contributions sum to the pre-unloading strain. Unloading at 180 s produces immediate recoil followed by approach to a 0.450% model residual. Constructed teaching data at 500 Pa engineering stress.
